  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8), // expect: directional
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Text(label),
          const Text('Undo'), // expect: raw-string
          Text(l10n.undo),
          Text('$label'),
          Icon(Icons.chevron_left), // expect: directional
          Align(alignment: Alignment.centerRight), // expect: directional
          Text('Done'), // app-check: allow raw-string fixture allow comment
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
